title: Play IAMF through native component decoders

definition.title: Play IAMF through native component decoders
definition.source_excerpt: Parse a restricted channel-based IAMF presentation, decode qualified component streams using browser audio decoders, and reconstruct its requested mix under one audio clock. Compare with a reference renderer including gain and trimming.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Prerequisite-only first: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route. If absent, record HOLD_ENV; if present, decide whether the small probe is warranted. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.initial_screen: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. definition.primary_metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
definition.scope_contract: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
definition.negative_control: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.

define.basis: Exact full-key mechanism, bounded workload, matched baseline and predeclared threshold.

prepare.basis: Fixtures, source/runtime hashes, independent PCM oracle, adverse and lifecycle controls pinned.

correctness.basis: Fresh actual IAMF admission reads stream groups from source through host ffprobe, rejects unsupported gain, copies qualified FLAC component, and native Chrome decodes/renders every96000stereo signed16samples exactly under one clock. Full offline render, unity gain, ended callback, closed context and truncated component rejection pass. Five alternating complete binary-delivery pairs including host admission/extraction or hostreference decode, source transfer, native render and cleanup cost168.838ms versus173.859ms, ratio0.97112 passes1.10 no-regression threshold. Earlier JSON transfer timings invalidated and preserved;404 transport failure preserved.

performance.basis: Pursue strict flatstereo one-element/layer zero-gain finite host-parser bridge. No general IAMF parameter automation/spatial rendering, browser-only parser, streaming seek or production admission. Cost is neutral at this bound, not proven speedup.
